title: The Art of Knowing What Matters · Why read this book?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: How do we notice what actually matters?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book examines wisdom as a problem of judgment, education, and artificial intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It distinguishes possessing information from understanding situations and deciding what matters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Classroom examples connect philosophical reflection with learning and the transfer of experience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The PHRONESIS research programme investigates the distillation of contextual judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Technical chapters discuss representations, evaluation, bias, and experiments that could challenge its hypotheses.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The central tension concerns what compression preserves when a decision depends on context.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This invitation is for readers facing too many signals, choices, and competing priorities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read The Art of Knowing What Matters to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
